EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Ref. No. : DEV/LND/ACQUI/3/4-9.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:

Description of the land to be acquired: Portions of Land (Extent about 0.7912 Hectare) depicted as from Lot Nos. 01 to 08 in the Preliminary Survey Plan bearing No. MR/2593, situated in the Village of Naotunna, in Grama Niladhari Division of Naotunna, in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Devinuwara, Matara District, Southern Province.
Lot No. 01 Name of land: Wandigehena and Mahagedara Watta; Description: Home Garden and mixed cultivation; Extent: 0.0034 Hectare.
Lot No. 02 Name of land: Wandigehena; Description: 63 Coconut trees between 15-20 years old, 05 Mahogani trees about 10 years old; Extent: 0.7394 Hectare.
Lot No. 03 Name of land: Wandigehena and Mahahena alias Halumanihige Watta; Description: Home garden and mixed cultivation; Extent: 0.0194 Hectare.
Lot No. 04 Name of land: Wandigehena alias Halumanihige Watta alias Godallahena; Description: Home garden and mixed cultivation; Extent: 0.0100 Hectare.
Lot No. 05 Name of land: Wandigehena and Kandagehena; Description: Home garden and mixed cultivation; Extent: 0.0008 Hectare.
Lot No. 06 Name of land: Wandigehena and Kandagehena; Description: Home garden and mixed cultivation; Extent: 0.0111 Hectare.
Lot No. 07 Name of land: Wandigehena and Wewagawadeniya; Description: Home garden and mixed cultivation; Extent: 0.0068 Hectare.
Lot No. 08 Name of land: Wandigehena and Kongahawatta; Description: Home garden and mixed cultivation; Extent: 0.0003 Hectare.

Total: 0.7912 Hectare All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Devinuwara on the 28th day of January, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 14th day of January

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.: NA/E/1/ACQ/2007/3.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land/servitude to be acquired: Lot 1 of the land called “Siyambalagaha Idama” in extent Hec. 0.0266 depicted in Plan No. PPU 4996 dated 30.10.2014 of the Surveyor General situated at Nattandiya of Meda Palatha of Divisional Secretary’s Division of Nattandiya in the District of Puttalam in North Western Province.
Lot No. 01 Name of Land: Siyambalagaha Idama; Claimed: Udaya Lakshman Wijesinghe Abeykoon; Extent: 0.0266 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretary’s Office of Nattandiya on the 04th day of March, 2015 at 2.30 p. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for the compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
